name: Sampark setu
description: Sampark Setu is a WhatsApp outreach and contact intelligence tool that lets you verify which contacts are on WhatsApp, extract group members, enrich business profiles, and send personalized messages safely from your own WhatsApp account, no WhatsApp Business API required. Designed with compliance and number safety in mind (human-paced, randomized delays, daily limits), it works via a Chrome extension and integrates with your tools via API and webhooks (including Sangam CRM). Ideal for Indian SMBs, solopreneurs, and sales teams focused on lead recovery and customer follow-ups.

events.n: View Daily Message Usage and Limit
events.d: Retrieve your current daily message usage and your sending limit.
Send personalized WhatsApp text to verified contacts. Supports up to 200 recipients and optional external IDs.
Check one or more phone numbers (E.164 format) to see if they are registered on WhatsApp.
Retrieve the status and detailed results of a WhatsApp number verification job, with optional status filters and summary counts.
